name: NUKLEUS VERSE
summary:
NUKLEUS VERSE brings meetings and collaboration into virtual reality. Create a meeting or join invited participants using a meeting code, meet as avatars, and communicate using live voice in the Compact Meeting Room.

Present and collaborate
Share PDF presentations, explore ideas with synchronized whiteboards and annotations, and access the web during meetings. Participant management and meeting controls support your collaboration sessions.
